paragraphs: Labrie Group designs and manufactures waste collection vehicles for the solid waste industry in North America. The trucks are sold under the Labrie, Leach, and Wittke brands. Since 1971 the company has distributed and supported those products through a distributor network spanning the United States and Canada.

Their clientele ranges from private entrepreneurs in the waste hauling sector to national waste management service providers. The customer base also counts hundreds of small towns and counties, as well as major municipalities and cities. The company describes servicing millions of citizens in cities and municipalities all over North America.

Labrie Group supports over 30 distributors across the United States and Canada, and those distributors have over 50 individual locations across North America. Maintenance, repairs, and retrofits are handled by technicians in St-Romuald, Quebec, CA, and Lafayette, GA, USA. Labrie Environmental Group is part of Hiab.
